title: Mail and Courier Lead Days on a Continuation Supply — Prescription Insurance on File
content:
A continuation supply billed under **Prescription Insurance on File** includes a delivery lead for a patient who receives prescriptions by delivery, read from the patient's delivery plan and completed deliveries under Delivery & Pickup Services.

## Rule

- Where the patient holds an **active Kestrel Mail Delivery** plan and a delivery to the patient was completed less than **6** whole months before the date of service, that plan's mail transit business days are added to the continuation days supply as mail lead, each business day counted as one calendar day of supply.
- Where the patient holds **any other active delivery plan** and such a delivery was completed, **1** day of courier lead is added.
- Otherwise no delivery lead is added.

## Reading the records

| Active delivery plan (Delivery & Pickup Services) | Completed delivery to the patient less than 6 whole months before the date of service | Delivery lead added |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Mail Delivery | Yes | Kestrel Mail Delivery's mail transit business days, as calendar days |
| Kestrel Mail Delivery | No | None |
| Any other plan, for example Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery or Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly | Yes | 1 day |
| Any other plan | No | None |
| No active delivery plan | — | None |

## The 6-month boundary (hypothetical dates, date of service 10 June)

- Last completed delivery on 11 December: 5 whole months have passed, less than 6 — the lead applies.
- Last completed delivery on 10 December: 6 whole months have passed, not less than 6 — no lead.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A patient with an active Kestrel Mail Delivery plan whose mail transit business days were 5, and a delivery completed on 2 May, receives a continuation supply dated 10 June: 5 days of mail lead are added. The same patient on an active Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass receives 1 day of courier lead.
